items.text: Had a fabulous stay in the beautiful home!  Our two dogs had the most wonderful time and felt like they had so much space to explore!  A cosy home with a great outdoor area and pool which we thoroughly enjoyed, would definitely recommend staying here and will definitely return in the future!  Thank you!!

This house had everything we needed! The well equipped kitchen made breakfast preparation a breeze.  The location was spot-on for exploring Nordeast and St Anthony Main. We had a great weekend and it was awesome to enjoy the hot tub with snow on the ground.

Great little place right on the edge of Zone 1! I had no problems accessing pretty much all of Central London from this location. Very sunny and warm room that reflects the house as a whole.  Sheridan was very accommodating as well as his roommates. He was off on an adventure of his own, but made sure that I had everything that I needed before heading out. His flatmates took over as hosts a bit and were nothing but nice and helpful.  Good options for breakfast within easy walking distance. I recommend the Electric Elephant! I was also given fridge space and could make food at the flat (a great option for the thrifty visitor of London!). Being so close to a MAJOR transit hub was key to my stay.  Truly a wonderful place to stay for my first ever trip to London.

We were a group of 12 and the apartment was just perfect. (exactly as described in the listing) Really perfect place to explore Lisbon. We also took the opportunity to enjoy a typical Portuguese dinner on New year's Eve in their recently renovated room downstairs. (Highly recommended)  Susana was always available if we needed anything. Can only recommend Intendente 1865 for a memorable time in Lisbon.

Wir waren mit der halben Forschungsgruppe (und Professor) zu fünft eine Woche lang auf einer Konferenz im CCIB und haben deshalb nach einer gemeinsamen Unterkunft in der Nähe gesucht. Die Wohnung war mit Lage, Raumaufteilung und Ausstattung perfekt für uns: Jeder hatte ein eigenes Zimmer, fast alle mit eigenem Bad (ja, man wartet ein wenig aufs Warmwasser, was aber unkritisch ist) und / oder Zugang zu einem von drei Balkons, teils auch mit Schreibtisch. Man hat zudem einen tollen Ausblick aufs Meer. Durch mehrere Schlüssel konnten wir ohne allzu komplizierte Absprachen unabhängig voneinander auf die Konferenz. Es gibt Ess- und Wohnzimmer sowie eine gut ausgestattete Küche. Dank diverser Stapel Handtücher, sowie Waschmaschine, Trockner und zur Verfügung gestellter Waschmittel konnten wir einigen Platz im Gepäck einsparen. Die Kommunikation mit LingJuan war meistens zügig und gut.   Zum CCIB und dem benachbarten großen Einkaufszentrum (mit Restaurants) Diagonal Mar läuft man 12min durch eine trotz dicker Straßen durchaus ruhige und sichere Gegend. Die nächste Metro-Station ist Selva de Mar - davon aus kommt man gut in die Innenstadt, was wir aber durch die Konferenz nur einmal genu

Thank you so much for your kindness and amazing flat! Next time we come to Rome, you will be the first person who will know it! :) Very confortable place to stay! Very central and clean!  Es war eine wunderbare Reise! Vanessa's Wohnung ist sehr zentral und leicht zu erreichen. Die nächste Metro-Station ist 3 Geh -Minuten entfernt. 2 Häuser weiter ist ein italienisches Restaurant was sehr empfehlenswert ist! Sehr gut und günstig! Abends immer super voll, aber wenn man warten muss, bekommt man direkt ein Glas Sekt als Entschädigung. (Dort gibt es auch WLan). Die Wohnung an sich ist super ausgestattet und sehr sauber! Es ist in einem Altbau, also kann es nachts ein wenig laut von draußen sein. Die Übergabe hat reibungslos funktioniert und Vanessa hat auch mal so eine SMS geschickt um zu sehen wie es uns geht! Haben uns dierkt heimisch bei ihr gefühlt! Wenn wir nächstes mal nach Rom reisen, wird sie die erste sein die es erfährt!

Just got back from a lovely stay at Yves's apartment. He is really friendly and helpful and met us at the apartment to show us in. The apartment is beautiful, very traditional, up a spiral staircase to a light and airy apartment with traditional balconies overlooking the street. The apartment was really clean, well equipped and spacious. As a family group we were able to make our own meals and relax between sightseeing in nice apartment rather than a cramped hotel room. Yves was very helpful and gave use some excellent restaurant recommendations and tips on getting around. The apartment's location is fab, a few seconds from the Rer station, next to the Luxembourg gardens, sorbonee and pantheon. There are lots of good restaurants, bars etc nearby. There are also lots of amenities, an excellent bakery over the road and grocery shops nearby. Thanks Yves.

Abigail welcomed us very warmly and friendly.  She was flexible about the check in.  We also talked much about the culture and some New Zealand stuff which was really interesting for us.  The accomodation is cute and we felt home really fast. We loved the quiet atmosphere around the nature and living animals there. I would always choose this accomodation again, if I visit Christchurch again. Thanks for hosting us!

Trine’s place is close to the city center. It is a small room. The bed is just a matrass so we didn’t sleep really good. The street is a nice but busy street. We had some troubles with the noise at night (bars and people) and early in the morning (garbage trucks at 6.30am making a lot of noise). So if you are sensitive to noise, I would recommend to bring good earplugs. The room was clean and Trine and her roommate were really friendly. We enjoyed our trip to Copenhagen!

1. Quiet house with pretty good coffee and brunch from various shops nearby. 2. Great location for access to various tourist attractions if you have a car or bring your own. 2-1) Even if you don't have a car, it was still accessible by foot and tram to enjoy St Kilda or the CBD. 3. The house is of course clean, furnished and equipped with everything we needed. 4. The host is very flexible enough to handle many veriable situations.

This place is amazing. Seth and Dorit were great hosts. They answered every question we had. The place is very romantic, cozy, clean, welcoming and special. It is close to everything important to do in San Diego. Great place!
Great host, friendly and great communication. Printworks just round the corner. Will be staying again.

Cara is not only a superhost: she is a friend to her guests, she cares a lot and can give you lots of suggestions for your daily trips. The lovely house is quiet and sorrounded by plants and flowers. Last but not least: the place it's a strategic headquarter to reach Dingle peninsula and Ring of Kerry. Perfect!
Kumiko is the sweetest! so happy she could host our stay! and her place was right next to a major station so that was very convenient! thank you🫶🏼

Chip and Angela's place is beautiful and stocked with everything you might need...including umbrellas.  It is a great location within the Haight to explore the neighborhood...it is on Ashbury and only a block from Haight.  It is also close to public transportation when you want to visit the rest of the city.  Chip answered all my texts quickly and gave us great tips on restaurants.  He is full of knowledge of the area and fun to talk to...make sure that you get to meet him.

Mariana's place is in a great location in an area with lots of street life, cafes (fantastic coffee at Chiquitito) and bars, and an easy walk/bike ride to Centro Historico, Condesa, Juarez and Roma. You can find Bici bikes just on the corner so it's easy to get anywhere, with bike lanes along Reforma and a pretty good bicycle culture wherever you ride. Mariana is lovely and the perfect host. She met us when we arrived and gave us a list and map (!)  of her favourite spots around the city. Followed by an email with extra ideas. The apartment is beautiful with two courtyard gardens that feel like you are in a lush jungle. It was winter when we stayed so it was a little fresh for a few days but then it warmed up. Fantastic  place, can't recommend it enough! Thanks Mariana, hope to see you again soon. Missing Mexico already! :)
Absolutely unreal! Location was amazing, clean and tidy, great amount of space. Would definitely go back!

I think its one of the best value for money aparment in Milan. Perfectly clean, nice and kind host and it is very close to the city centre. We stayed there for 5 days and we had 0 problems whatsoever. A real 10/10 stay.

Nicolo was a great host from start to end, very easy and welcoming experience.  Apartment is right next to the metro and has a bus stop infront making the the whole city easily accessible. Also has a supermarket next to it very convenient. Would stay again when I come back to Rome
Flasta was very helpful. The penthouse was clean with great views and with all the windows was light and appealing. The location was also very good being walking distance to Southbank.
Really good ! Clean, quiet and comfy. I liked their spirit. They do Airbnb to meet people and you can feel it the way they welcome you.

The place was clean and comfortable and exactly as described - ticked all the boxes for a short stay! Stephanie was fast in responding to any questions we had and the place is close to public transport and the Maribyrnong river.

Mariano and his wife were the nicest welcoming Airbnb hosts I have ever met.  Very hospitable. Their place felt like a true bed and breakfast and very homey with the personal touches of toiletries provided, daily making the bed and breakfast offered every morning. They were responsive and provided guides to the best local restaurants and sites to visit. The place was clean and located about a 3-5 minute walk to Vatican City. Book here, you won’t regret the best Airbnb experience you’ll ever have!!!!
We really love our stay with Ashraf! He was really nice and helped us a lot with the check in. The bedroom is big and clean and the house is well situated in London.

Great place to stay!  Very close to all the local attractions and restaurants.  The place is at a more peaceful part of the town with lots of privacy.  Christina is super helpful, you can reach out to her about anything and she is very quick to get back to you.

A lovely apartment in a wonderful location!  A quiet street but very  close to the charming old town. Also right next to Turia park, where we walked most mornings.  Lots of great little restaurants, great value and wonderful food ( especially the grilled vegetables and octopus!) also fun to shop at one of the two markets and cook at home.  Our only regret was that we had to cut our visit short due to COVID, everything closing down and our having to return home.  We will be back to Valencia and this lovely apartment!

Great location and beautiful apartment. Tiring to be on the 6th floor but worth it and also right next to an amazing fruit and vegetable store. Communication was perfect and was simple and easy to get into the building. Would definitely stay again and would recommend to others. Thank you so much !!

What a great place! The pictures of the view don’t do it justice. The location is convenient and close to all the amenities needed to have a good time in Cape Town.  Kathy is a great host, always responsive and quick to solve any problems.  We stayed in this unit for three weeks, and have nothing but good things to say about Kathy and the unit. The concierge was one of the best. Couple things to note….  - can get hot on the upper level on hot days, the AC was great but needs a couple hrs to get the upper area cool. Loadshedding is fine, but hot when the AC isn’t running.  - location is so good you spend too much money at the local attractions and restaurants 😋 Things to do: - paragliding R1550pp - kayaking w/ dolphins R1000pp - hiking up table mountain - Uber black avrg per trip about R100 in the CBD Overall 10/10 would do it again.

Such an amazing stay and great value for money! Penny and Richards house was the cleanest we had stayed in in our two months backpacking New Zealand and Australia. It was clean and tidy, and the facilities are great. Penny made us delicious breakfast every day, which was just amazing. We got coffe/tea, and had our own bedroom, bathroom, toilet and lounge. Their house was HUGE and so was the garden. Penny and Richard were almost too nice to us, and really went out of their way to make our stay comfortable. They reccomended good walks, markets and other things to do in the area. It was an amazing place to sleep, and also relax a day if we felt like it. They had a smart TV in the lounge, so we could log onto our netflix and watch a movie in the evening. We almost felt guilty for paying so little for such a great stay. Feels like visiting family. We hope we can return the favor if they ever visit Norway some day! Would definitly come back. Thank you so much for the great ending to our vacation.

Un angolo di paradiso a due minuti dal centro! Ho soggiornato con la mia famiglia la settimana di ferragosto presso Aroma Garden ed è stata un'esperienza meravigliosa. L'appartamento si trova all'interno di un residence recintato e molto curato su un altopiano a due minuti di macchina dal centro del paese e questo permette di godere di silenzio e tranquillità in un contesto curato e rilassante. L'host Giuseppe fornisce il pass per parcheggiare nell'area residenti, quindi pur avendo soggiornato nel periodo di altissima stagione non abbiamo mai avuto difficoltà nel parcheggiare l'auto in centro. La casa è attrezzata di tutto (2 televisori, forno, frullatore, ferro da stiro con caldaia, microonde...) e curata nei minimi particolari. L'host Giuseppe e la sua collaboratrice Valentina sono stati gentilissimi e superdisponibili fornendoci consigli e informazioni utili per visitare la zona.  Abbiamo lasciato il cuore ad Aroma Garden e speriamo di poter tornare in futuro. Davvero super consigliato!!!
Great reception and communication from Tamar. The place was in a very relaxed area with nice surroundings. She was really supportive during the stay.
No word to describe my period in Alessandro apartment all was easy, quick and kind. Good location to live the real Palermo life.

The room was exactly as described, very spacious, well-lit and very comfortable and I couldn't have asked for a better host! Adina was very helpful and accommodating and overall, a very lovely person to stay with. The flat is VERY centrally located, less than a 5 minute walk from Elephant & Castle, which is very close to central London by tube and also within walking distance to some of London's famous landmarks.

Wow on the point with service and location in North Bronx, NY. Vie was a pleasure to deal with and the apartment was ready when we arrived early. I will be back when I need a place in the Bronx. The place was ideal for a home away from from home. My personal stamp of Approval is sealed!!!

Lovely stay at Hugh’s place - it’s definitely compact but has everything you need, is clean and the outside roof terrace is a fantastic bonus. Hugh was incredibly helpful with suggestions for local restaurants and activities. The area (and in fact all of Seville) feels safe, night and day. We were able to check in early and check out late due to our flight times which was greatly appreciated. Thank you Hugh for a wonderful first time stay in Sevilla. Siân and Dean :)
superb place. very clean and big. Provided luggage drop off before check in. always available to help.

Matches the photos. Easy self check-in and very responsive host.  The space was clean, modern and well equipped with a full stocked kitchen with modern appliances, plates, silverware etc. Bed was comfortable too. Washer/Dryer available for use in building from 3pm-12am - detergent pods provided (major pro)! Things to be mindful of: A) The air conditioning is not strong and does not go below 21°C.  B) You’ll have to go downstairs to use the bathroom in the night. C) The apartment is not very sound proofed. You can hear neighbors moving things around which wasn’t too disturbing, but when going to bed and in the mornings, you can hear voices, cars and commotion outside very well. If you’re a light sleeper that’s something to be mindful of! Only con: In the bathroom, there seems to be mold growing on the wall where you hang your towels and where steam comes up from the shower. We placed our towels elsewhere but I’d be weary for people staying more than a night.

We love most the neighborhood! Family oriented great host, friendly environment :) home is pet friendly as stated! Clean and spacious… extremely accommodating. We enjoyed our stay! Lovely Home, Thanks ❤️

Lindsey was a wonderful guest with a beautiful home to match. She had everything we needed, and we felt right at home. Comfortable beds and pillows, large bathroom and kitchen, not to mention close to everything. The place was incredibly clean as well. We can't wait to go back!

A lovely apartment, looks exactly as it is advertised. It is also very conveniently  located. Since we arrived sooner than expected, we asked Maxime whether he could get to the apartment earlier, and he and Julia were quick to help with this. Maxime  also immediately responded any questions. We really enjoyed our stay in this place!

There are extremely few places like this in the world so just book it! Seriously though, you can fall asleep to the sound of gentle waves and wake up, open the curtains and balcony OVER THE SEA to an uninterrupted panoramic view of the ocean. Because of that we even woke up before dawn one morning to watch the sunrise over the sea... from your room. Oh also you are in a stunning extremely old building in the very centre of the old town so evenings are a blissful stroll around the neighbourhood. We had a car parked nearby (avoiding the historic zone where driving is somewhat prohibited) and did some day trips to Alberobello & Ostuni but it was always a pleasure to come back to the property. The place is well equipped (full size fridge and dining table!) and Donatella was very helpful and communicative throughout. We lost power once when we tried to make breakfast but a simple flip of the fuse box sorted it all immediately. There was no WiFi in the room which made things a bit tricky to plan but not the end of the world and somewhat a relief when starting a holiday. Obviously it's a historic property and not a modern hotel room so some consideration is required such as poor phone rec

The hosts, Glenn and Oliver, are truly caring people. They went above and beyond for me when I had a wardrobe problem, as I was running very late to get a wedding I had traveled in for.  They seem as they were born to be B & B hosts - among the many other hobbies cool they have. If you are artistic, you will particularly love being surrounding by the beautiful Victorian details in the home - beautiful wood finishes and floors, stained glass windows, wrought iron, framed art,  and the charm of the slanted ceiling eaves. Everything about your stay is as advertised, and your stay will be seamless. It is the perfect choice. We slept so soundly and peacefully.  We only stayed for one night, but it is the kind of place I wish I could stay at for a longer time and pretend I was a gal living in the late 19th century.
J.C.'s place is beautiful and impeccably clean. We had an amazing time and would definitely visit again.
We had a very pleasant stay. The location was extremely central and the hosts were very polite and responsive, the house was clean and comfortable. We would definitely book it again.

Location is fantastic, in the heart of the action but down a quieter side street so there was not too much street noise. Maria was so helpful and responsive. There is a supermarket within 2 minutes walk and all the attractions are also within walking distance. The apartment is in excellent condition, bedrooms are a great size, there are shutters that can be closed to keep out the light at night. There are some basics in the pantry which was very useful and lastly the shower was excellent.  Would definitely stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay here. The space was very cool, all open air living, except for the bedroom and bathroom - so I wasn't sure how private it would feel, but there was so much greenery around that it felt very private, and all around awesome. It was also super clean! and the hosts Heather, and the caretaker Paul were very welcoming and quick to respond to all our questions.  Location was great too if you're into snorkelling or exploring. Two of the best snorkelling spots on the island are just a short drive from here. And there are some great local markets if you're into fresh grown fruits & veggies, like us.  Would highly recommend staying here if you get a chance.
Very nice stay in Porto ! Thank you Alexandre for your hospitality. The room was perfectly designed and cleaned. Everything was great ! I recommend this AirBnb ;-)

This place has a lot of fire code violations. The room I was given the first night smelled heavily like smoke (and was a non-smoking room). I asked to be moved to a quieter area of the hotel and was told by the front desk staff that all of the rooms are loud. The following day I was trapped in the room bathroom due to a sliding door being off track (fire violation 1). The man that came to fix it got it fixed fairly quickly and was the friendliest staff at the entire hotel. That same day, I came back to the locking mechanism on the door no longer working. The front desk staff was unable to open it with a key card or master key. My dog was inside and I was unable to get her out (fire violation 2) Due to the lock being broken on the room, I was moved to another room the second night of my stay. I was told that I was going to be charged a smoking fee for the original room (I did not smoke in there) and that I would not be refunded/compensated for the issues that were 100% the hotels fault (again, multiple fire code violations). The second room I was given had no light switch plate and exposed wires. There is a lot of work that still needs to be done to this hotel. They shouldn't be ren
Amazing apartment, the bathroom is AWESOME. COmmunication was great. The only setback is the location. Otherwise, this place is awesome.

I have never felt so at home away from home at an Airbnb. Chris' warm and welcoming manner, artistic decoration, and generous extras made our stay stellar. My friend and I spent the week writing our respective novels. Fifty-five Springhurst was the perfect location for our writing intensive, and we hope to book more time in the future at this excellent airbnb. Thank you Chris for providing such a lovely place to visit. Much appreciation!
